title: 138 kV RL Line Energization Transient
description: Single-phase 138 kV source energizing a series RL transmission feeder into a resistive-inductive substation load with DC offset transient.
code:
BEGIN NEW DATA CASE
C 138 kV Single-Phase RL Transmission Line Energization Transient
C Time step: 20 us, Simulation duration: 80 ms (4.8 cycles at 60 Hz)
  2.0E-5  0.08
/BRANCH
C Source impedance and 138 kV overhead line
SRC138  LINE_A  1.2500  18.5000  0.0000
LINE_A  LOAD_B  3.8000  42.0000  0.0000
LOAD_B  GND     85.0000 35.0000  0.0000
BLANK RECORD
/SWITCH
C Circuit breaker closing at voltage zero-crossing (t = 4.167 ms) for max DC offset
SRC138  LINE_A  0.004167    1.000000
BLANK RECORD
/SOURCE
C 138 kVrms L-L => 112.68 kV peak L-G at 60 Hz
14 SRC138  112676.00   60.00    0.00
BLANK RECORD
/OUTPUT
SRC138 LINE_A LOAD_B
BLANK RECORD

title: 500 kV Back-to-Back Capacitor Bank Switching
description: High-frequency inrush current and transient overvoltage during 500 kV substation shunt capacitor bank energization with current-limiting reactor.
code:
BEGIN NEW DATA CASE
C 500 kV Substation Back-to-Back Shunt Capacitor Bank Switching
C Captures high-frequency inrush oscillation and bus voltage magnification
  5.0E-6  0.05
/BRANCH
C System equivalent impedance behind 500 kV bus
SYS500  BUS500  1.8000  38.0000  0.0000
C Existing energized capacitor bank C1 (100 MVAR at 500 kV)
BUS500  CAP1    0.2500   0.1500  0.0000
CAP1    GND     0.1000   0.0000  1.0610
C Switched capacitor bank C2 with 0.8 mH inrush-limiting reactor
BUS500  CAP2_R  0.4000   0.8000  0.0000
CAP2_R  GND     0.1500   0.0000  1.0610
C Substation load feeder
BUS500  FEEDER  4.2000  28.0000  0.0450
FEEDER  GND     180.000 12.0000  0.0000
BLANK RECORD
/SWITCH
C Breaker energizes bank C2 at peak voltage (t = 12.5 ms) and clears at 45 ms
BUS500  CAP2_R  0.012500    0.045000
BLANK RECORD
/SOURCE
C 500 kVrms L-L => 408.25 kV peak L-G at 60 Hz
14 SYS500  408248.00   60.00    0.00
BLANK RECORD
/OUTPUT
SYS500 BUS500 CAP1 CAP2_R FEEDER
BLANK RECORD

title: Distributed Transmission Line Lightning Surge
description: Multi-section pi-cascade representation of a 230 kV overhead transmission corridor subjected to a double-exponential lightning impulse and tower footing ground resistance.
code:
BEGIN NEW DATA CASE
C 230 kV Overhead Transmission Line Lightning Surge Traveling Wave Study
C Sub-microsecond time step for steep-front surge propagation
  5.0E-7  0.002
/BRANCH
C Surge impedance of lightning strike channel (400 Ohms)
STRIKE  TOWER1  400.000  0.0000  0.0000
C Tower 1 surge impedance and footing resistance (15 Ohms)
TOWER1  FOOT1   150.000  0.0250  0.0000
FOOT1   GND     15.0000  0.0000  0.0000
C Span 1 (350 m overhead conductor: Zc = 380 Ohms)
TOWER1  SPAN1   0.0420   0.4500  0.0000
SPAN1   GND     0.0000   0.0000  0.0031
C Span 2 toward substation gantry
SPAN1   SUB_IN  0.0420   0.4500  0.0000
SUB_IN  GND     0.0000   0.0000  0.0031
C Substation transformer entrance capacitance (2.5 nF) and magnetizing branch
SUB_IN  XFMR_H  0.5000   2.5000  0.0000
XFMR_H  GND     1200.00  85.0000 0.0025
BLANK RECORD
/SWITCH
C Sparkover gap at substation entrance closes if surge exceeds threshold
SUB_IN  XFMR_H  0.000010    0.001800
BLANK RECORD
/SOURCE
C Impulse surge injection (450 kV peak equivalent) + 230 kV AC pre-stress
14 STRIKE  450000.00   5000.00   0.00
14 XFMR_H  187794.00   60.00     0.00
BLANK RECORD
/OUTPUT
STRIKE TOWER1 SPAN1 SUB_IN XFMR_H
BLANK RECORD

title: ZnO Surge Arrester Substation Insulation Coordination
description: 345 kV GIS substation switching surge insulation coordination referencing an external ZnO metal-oxide surge arrester library via $INCLUDE.
code:

C 345 kV Substation Insulation Coordination with ZnO Surge Arrester Library
  2.0E-6  0.04
/BRANCH
C System equivalent and incoming 345 kV overhead line
SYS345  LINE_S  2.1000  34.0000  0.0000
LINE_S  BUS345  3.6000  52.0000  0.0380
C GIS busbar to autotransformer bushing
BUS345  TX_HV   0.1800   1.4500  0.0045
TX_HV   GND     950.00  68.0000  0.0032
BLANK RECORD
/SWITCH
C Line energization breaker closing at peak voltage
SYS345  LINE_S  0.004167    0.038000
BLANK RECORD
/SOURCE
C 345 kVrms L-L => 281.69 kV peak L-G at 60 Hz
14 SYS345  281691.00   60.00    0.00
BLANK RECORD
/OUTPUT
SYS345 LINE_S BUS345 TX_HV
BLANK RECORD
C External ZnO surge arrester piecewise V-I library
$INCLUDE, zno_arrester.lib

title: 3-Phase Underground Cable & Transformer Ferroresonance Study
description: Multi-file EMT study of single-pole switching on an underground XLPE cable feeding a lightly loaded saturable distribution transformer using JMarti punch and saturable core libraries.
code:
BEGIN NEW DATA CASE
C 3-Phase Underground XLPE Cable & Transformer Ferroresonance Study
C Models single-pole fuse clearing leaving cable capacitance in series with core
  1.0E-5  0.20
/BRANCH
C 34.5 kV Substation source impedance (Phases A, B, C)
SRC_A   BUS_A   0.3500   4.8000  0.0000
SRC_B   BUS_B   0.3500   4.8000  0.0000
SRC_C   BUS_C   0.3500   4.8000  0.0000
C Underground XLPE cable section (350 m, 0.28 uF/km per phase)
BUS_A   CBL_A   0.0950   0.2100  0.0000
CBL_A   GND     0.0000   0.0000  0.0980
BUS_B   CBL_B   0.0950   0.2100  0.0000
CBL_B   GND     0.0000   0.0000  0.0980
BUS_C   CBL_C   0.0950   0.2100  0.0000
CBL_C   GND     0.0000   0.0000  0.0980
BLANK RECORD
/SWITCH
C Phase A fuse opens at t = 0.025 s while Phases B and C remain energized
BUS_A   CBL_A   0.000000    0.025000
BUS_B   CBL_B   0.000000    0.200000
BUS_C   CBL_C   0.000000    0.200000
BLANK RECORD
/SOURCE
C 34.5 kVrms L-L => 28.17 kV peak L-G balanced 3-phase at 60 Hz
14 SRC_A   28169.00   60.00     0.00
14 SRC_B   28169.00   60.00  -120.00
14 SRC_C   28169.00   60.00   120.00
BLANK RECORD
/OUTPUT
BUS_A CBL_A CBL_B CBL_C
BLANK RECORD
C External JMarti frequency-dependent cable punch and saturable transformer core
$INCLUDE, jmarti_line.pch
$INCLUDE, xfmr_sat.lib
